title: Aspire Nexi One Classic Tobacco Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg
description: Experience the rich, full-bodied flavour of traditional tobacco with Aspire Nexi's Classic Tobacco flavour prefilled pods. Each pod delivers a satisfying and smooth tobacco taste, perfect for those who appreciate the classic tobacco experience. These 20mg nicotine salt pods offer a balanced throat hit and rapid nicotine delivery, ideal for ex-smokers or vapers seeking efficient relief from nicotine cravings. The pods come in a convenient pack of three, each filled with 1.2ml of e-liquid and designed to provide up to 350 puffs. With an integrated 1.6ohm coil, the Nexi pods mimic the traditional crispy MTL (mouth-to-lung) cigarette experience, just without the smoke. The integration with Aspire Nexi’s easy-to-use device ensures a hassle-free vaping experience with no mess or refilling required.
